title: Quick Jammy Norwegian Stilton Cheese Bowl
description: A low-fat, meal-prep Norwegian dish made with tender cheese, air-fried and served in an earthenware bowl. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or lunch.
instructions: Place the sliced almonds in the air fryer basket and cook for 2 minutes, shaking halfway through.
In a medium bowl, mix together the frozen mixed berries, honey, and lemon juice until well combined.
Add the chopped fresh mint leaves to the berry mixture and stir to combine.
Cut the Stilton cheese into small pieces and add to the berry mixture, stirring gently to combine.
Transfer the cheese and berry mixture to an earthenware bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional fresh mint leaves if desired.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days.
